scope: Offline private-validator startup and warm-restart observation admission with synthetic process/RPC fixtures; no actual Agave execution

localValidation.skipReason: Real Linux process-name fixture requires Linux

checks: Named readiness and failed connection reads may retry within the existing deadline
Wrong genesis/identity/version, supply/inflation/stake or finalized-history failures abort
Malformed or unknown observations, redirects and unexpected HTTP/RPC replies refuse
Partial selected vote sets and unrooted/low-slot progress remain explicit readiness only after identity and supply checks
Synthetic later healthy responses cannot hide a preceding integrity failure
Both complete startup and post-restart failure fixtures clean every owned child; explicit startup readiness can still recover
Low-slot and partial-vote readiness cannot mask a simultaneous supply or vote-identity mismatch
remainingRequirements: Capable Linux host, actual fresh hashing genesis and startup replay
Actual full-validator consensus/restart and separate failure/recovery drills
Independent operators, funded backing/custody, bridge security and explicit release decision
